scope: Actual three-normal tangent-chart geometry for ambient dimension n+3, including tangent dimension zero. An arbitrary given orthonormal normal frame is extended with its rays fixed in the last3 coordinates. The exact affine-plane image, a genuine Euclidean affine-isometry object, normal/tangent norm and kernel factorization, measurability and physical rotated-section equality are all proved. No Gaussian-law, Fubini, surface or canonical mass supplier is an input.
